Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin Samurai, adding {R}.
When the Goblin Samurai dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning the Goblin Samurai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Oathkeeper's equip ability by paying {1} due to Éowyn, attaching it to the Goblin Samurai.
Repeat.

413-7124-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
413-7124-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7759.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
When the token(s) enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

713-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

1170-2478-5006.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-2478-5006.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1636-3789-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-3789-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

2105-7196-7297.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

1618-2056-2440-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
1618-2056-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2056-2440-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

457-1329-4779-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-4779-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

3097-5641-7173.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

851-2034-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2034-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1129-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
1129-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

934-4365-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-3470-4826-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3470-4826-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

1193-2743-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Mythos of Illuna and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Mythos of Illuna copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2981-4871-6291.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1548-3484-3487-5870-6320.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}
1548-3484-3487-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Port Razer that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Port Razer token enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc, Decoction Module and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Deal combat damage with the Port Razer token. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-308-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

5184-5436-5742-5743.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2446-3750-5231.notablePrerequisites: Living Hive does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2446-3750-5231.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive.
Living Hive triggers, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability at least five times by sacrificing at least five Insects, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
